title: Pan-fried gnocchi with chicken and pesto

items: 1 large boneless skinless chicken breast (about 10 oz), cut into ¾-inch pieces

steps: Pat the chicken dry and season with the salt and pepper.
Heat 1 Tbsp oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat until it shimmers. Cook the chicken 5–7 min, turning once or twice, until golden and it reads 165°F in the thickest piece. Move to a plate.
Lower the heat to medium and add the remaining 1 Tbsp oil. Break apart any gnocchi stuck together and add them straight from the package in a single layer. No boiling needed.
Cook 4–5 min without stirring, until the bottoms are golden. Toss and cook 3–4 min more, until golden on most sides and soft inside when you bite one.
Turn off the heat. Return the chicken and any juices, add the pesto and toss to coat.
Top with parmesan and fresh basil and serve.
tips: If the gnocchi are still chewy inside, add 2 Tbsp water, cover 1–2 min to steam, then uncover and let them crisp again.
Add 1 cup halved cherry tomatoes with the pesto for color.
storage: Best fresh; the gnocchi lose their crisp edges in the fridge. Leftovers keep up to 3 days. Reheat in a skillet over medium heat 4–5 min, until the chicken reaches 165°F.
